concept_source.prompt_summary: Rear three-quarter SD biped cow lingpet Milkring; goggles strap/side visor, no visible eyes, minimal future milk tank gear, #ff00ff source background.

autosprite.prompt: Create a seamless idle breathing loop for an in-game SD companion. Keep Milkring in the same rear three-quarter back view every frame; do not turn to front or side. No visible eyes; goggles are only a rear strap and side blue visor. Gentle belly/chest breathing, ears and tail subtle bob, tiny cyan ring-core pulse, small back milk tank bob. Feet planted, no walking, no milk firing, no extra gear. Stable scale/center, generous transparent margins.
